summary: Iteration-2 testing of FLORAai: 12 plant species, live camera, dark mode, weekly digest cron, admin outbreaks. 35/35 backend tests pass (previous iter1 tz-datetime + brute-force bugs are FIXED). Frontend: 11/12 feature checks pass. One frontend bug: in Settings page the theme-select change does NOT apply the new theme immediately (html.dark is not added until the user clicks Save and reloads). The spec requires immediate preview. Navbar theme-toggle works correctly (light<->dark), persistence works, all 12 plant cards render on homepage, Dashboard spice-select contains all 12 options including the 6 new ones (Tulsi, Neem, Mango, Aloe Vera, Coconut, Money Plant), Dashboard open-camera-button opens camera-dialog with capture/cancel buttons, Admin outbreaks card renders with regional severity data, cron /api/cron/weekly-digest returns 200/accepted with valid bearer, 401 without/wrong token, and 200/duplicate on duplicate X-Webhook-Id.

ui_bugs.issue: Selecting 'Dark' does not apply dark theme immediately. html.className stays 'light' for >2.5s after selection. Only applies after Save + page reload (when ThemeSync picks up user.preferences.theme). Root cause: ThemeSync useEffect fires whenever AuthContext user reference changes (e.g. from focus-refetch or Settings re-render), overriding the live setTheme('dark') call from onValueChange with the stale user.preferences.theme='light'. Fix: either (a) make ThemeSync only run once on mount (ref-check), or (b) in Settings onValueChange, also update user.preferences.theme optimistically via setUser, or (c) guard ThemeSync so it does not re-fire if next-themes already has a matching/different theme set.

action_items: Fix ThemeSync overriding Settings page live theme preview. Suggested: guard ThemeSync so it only applies user.preferences.theme on initial mount (use a ref flag), OR in Settings onValueChange, do setUser({...user, preferences:{...user.preferences, theme:v}}) alongside setTheme(v). Expected behaviour per spec: switching the Settings theme-select immediately applies the theme, and the subsequent Save persists it.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/server.py admin_outbreaks does an await db.users.find_one in a loop keyed by uid; cached via locmap so OK, but a single $lookup pipeline would be cleaner for larger datasets.
cron/weekly-digest correctly dedupes via X-Webhook-Id; consider adding a TTL index on cron_runs collection (otherwise it grows forever).

Settings page uses `user.preferences?.theme || 'light'` which is correct, but ThemeSync component unconditionally reapplies user.preferences.theme on every user reference change, which is the root cause of the live-preview bug.
Camera dialog has an a11y warning ('Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent') — minor accessibility fix.

success_rate.frontend: 92% (11/12 checks; theme live-preview is the only miss)

seed_data_creation: No new seed data. iter2 tests only POST to cron (fire-and-forget) and GET read-only admin/outbreaks.

After main agent fixes ThemeSync (apply once on mount using a ref), re-run only the Settings theme live-preview check. Headless camera has no device so camera-capture-button cannot actually capture; verified presence + cancel path only, as spec allows.
